The NTTC urges the Commission to retain its present jurisdiction over tank truck operators by exempting them from the proposed rules.
The interest of carriers engaged in the transportation of household goods is represented by the Movers' & Warehousemen's Association of America, Inc. (MWAA). It argues that the proposed expansion will increase the number of movers offering duplicating services and result in an increase in the number of trucks on the road causing traffic congestion, waste of fuel, and air pollution. It contends that the consumer will suffer because unregulated movers operating within the expanded zones will not be subject to Commission regulations which protect the public interest. It argues that since almost every van contains three or four shipments, it is possible that one van may transport both regulated and unregulated shipments at the same time and this will result in discriminatory rates. For these reasons, the MWAA requests that carriers of household goods be exempted from the proposed regulations and that the existing commercial zone regulations be maintained for their segment of the motor carrier industry.
